body:
**STEAM SKIES**
=================================
### *A Create: Aeronautics Modded Survival Server*
 **NeoForge 1.21.1**

---

> *"Where steam meets sky, and factories never sleep."*

Welcome to **Steam Skies** — a heavily modded survival world built around **Create**, **Create: Aeronautics**, and a huge library of tech, exploration, and building mods. And it all runs smoothly because everyone follows a simple set of rules. Read the rules before you play!

---

## Table of Contents
- [General Conduct](#-general-conduct)
- [Griefing & Factories](#-griefing--factories)
- [War, PvP & Consent](#️-war-pvp--consent)

---
## Question/Report
- Go to [our ticket page](http://zserver.hopto.org:3000/) and submit your request

---

## General Conduct
- Be respectful in chat and voice — no harassment, hate speech, or discrimination.
- No spamming, chat flooding, or advertising other servers/communities.
- Listen to staff decisions. Disagreements can be appealed calmly and privately.
- Keep content SFW — no NSFW builds, skins, or language.
- English is the primary language in public chat; feel free to use others in private/team chats.

---

## Griefing & Factories
- **No griefing.** Destroying, sabotaging, or tampering with another player's builds, machines, or **Create factories** without permission is strictly forbidden.
- Do not steal from unclaimed *or* claimed contraptions, chests, storage systems, or vaults.
- Accidentally broke something? Report it immediately and offer to help repair it — accidents happen, unreported damage does not fly.
- Claiming land and factories through the server's claim system is **strongly encouraged** and protects your builds automatically.
- No explosive traps, TNT cannons, or hidden hazards aimed at griefing unsuspecting players.

---

## War, PvP & Consent
- **No unsolicited war or combat.** Conflict between players, teams, or nations requires **explicit consent from every party involved.**
- Ambushes, raids, sieges, and PvP battles must be agreed upon *beforehand*, either verbally or in writing (chat logs count as proof).
- Consent can include limits — e.g. *"one battle only," "no explosives," "no airship bombing runs"* — and agreed terms must be respected by all sides.
- Breaking agreed terms or attacking without consent is treated as griefing/harassment and may lead to penalties.
- Airship and **Create: Aeronautics** combat follows the same rules — no surprise aerial strikes or bombing runs without consent.
- Ceasefires and peace treaties are valid and enforceable once agreed upon by both sides.

---

## Nations & Teams
- Players may freely form **nations, factions, guilds, or teams** — claim territory, build capitals, raise flags, and set up borders.
- Nations should register their name, leadership, and territory with staff for record-keeping and dispute resolution.
- Alliances, trade deals, and treaties between nations are encouraged and can be formalized in writing (signs, books).
- Annexation, occupation, or territory disputes must go through the **war consent process** above — no forced takeovers without agreement.
- Abandoned or inactive nation territory may be reclaimed by admins after a set inactivity period (Ask staff for current timing).

---

## Aeronautics & Machinery
- Fly respectfully — no reckless airship crashes into other players' bases, factories, or builds.
- Build large mechanical contraptions (trains, factories, airships) with **performance and lag** in mind — chunk-loaded builds should be optimized.
- Yield right-of-way on shared train tracks; don't block or sabotage public rail lines.
- Public airspace near spawn and shared hubs is a no-fly-combat zone at all times, consent or not.

---

## Land & Claims
- Use the server's claim tools to protect your base, factory, or nation's territory.
- Respect claim boundaries — no building directly on/against another player's claim without permission.
- Avoid excessive strip-mining or deforestation near spawn and other shared public areas.

---

## Economy & Trade
- Player shops, markets, and trade routes are welcome and encouraged.
- Scamming other players in trades or contracts is not tolerated.
- Duped or exploited items may not be used in trades, shops, or contracts (see Bugs & Exploits below).

---

## Bugs & Exploits
- Found a duplication glitch, exploit, or lag machine? **Report it to staff** — do not use or share it.
- Exploiting bugs for personal or nation gain results in item rollback and possible punishment.
- Performance-breaking machines (excessive entity cramming, chunk-loaders, etc.) may be asked to be modified or removed by staff.

---

## Punishments
Violating these rules may result in, depending on severity and history:
1. Verbal warning
2. Temporary mute or ban
3. Permanent ban

Staff decisions are final but can be appealed through the appropriate channel.

---

## Final Word
**Steam Skies** is a collaborative world — nations will rise, factories will roar, and airships will darken the sky. Just make sure every battle, alliance, and betrayal happens **by choice, not by force.**

*Fly safe, build smart, and may your conveyor belts never jam.*

---
*Last updated: July 2026*
